review_type: AI content rubric assessment, not runtime benchmark
target: unmodified source SKILL.md and README.md, excluding AIMax additions
item_id_mapping: Checker table order: T1 China localization, T2 safety; companion structural evaluator uses different T1/T2 order. Labels are authoritative.
editorial_decision: accepted for a narrowly scoped English handoff convention, with explicit installation and evidence limitations

items.label: China localization
items.rationale: SKILL.md: English-only instructions and examples; does not meet the original Chinese-localization criterion.

items.label: Safety
items.rationale: SKILL.md: declarative formatting instructions, no executable files or account access; installer behavior changes persistent instructions, without an explicit safety checklist.

items.label: Boundary transparency
items.rationale: SKILL.md: narrow footer task and automatic/manual distinction are explicit; no three-class boundary section.

items.label: Data privacy
items.rationale: SKILL.md: no data transport code; no redaction guidance for status text or credentials.

items.label: Exception handling
items.rationale: SKILL.md: yellow names a pending item and red identifies needed input; no handling of contradictory task evidence.

items.label: Functional completeness
items.rationale: SKILL.md: all three states, output location and length are specified for this narrow task.

items.label: Stability with ambiguity
items.rationale: SKILL.md: choose from the user perspective; no explicit mixed-state or unknown-evidence policy.

items.label: Fallback
items.rationale: SKILL.md: manual use is offered; no instruction-conflict or unsupported-host fallback procedure.

items.label: Capability boundaries
items.rationale: SKILL.md: response footer convention is specific; lacks three groups with three examples each.

items.label: Trigger precision
items.rationale: SKILL.md frontmatter and Status Block: intent and completed-unit trigger are clear; nested partial units are not defined.

items.label: Audience breadth
items.rationale: README.md: multiple agents, long-running work and partial handoffs are named; no host-specific onboarding.

items.label: Customization
items.rationale: SKILL.md: manual following supported; no supported preference or customization interface.

items.label: Progressive disclosure
items.rationale: README.md and SKILL.md provide short entry and detail; no deep references layer.

items.label: Structure clarity
items.rationale: SKILL.md: brief named sections, bullet rules and three clear examples.

items.label: Anti-patterns
items.rationale: SKILL.md: forbids trailing content, separators and spacer lines; no three bad/good comparison cases.

items.label: FAQ depth
items.rationale: SKILL.md and README.md: no FAQ or deep FAQ.

items.label: Output accuracy
items.rationale: SKILL.md: actual concise status and user-perspective state required; no explicit evidence-verification step.

items.label: Content completeness
items.rationale: SKILL.md: narrow three-state convention is covered; mixed-state and no-evidence edge cases absent.

items.label: Added value
items.rationale: SKILL.md: semantic distinction, length bound and persistent/manual modes; few additional features by design.

items.label: Ready to use
items.rationale: README.md: install command; SKILL.md has three copyable output examples; installer itself not present in snapshot.
